title: THE KNOCK
message: Something is about to ask for your attention.
meaning:
The Knock is arrival before the arrival. News, a person, an offer or an event is approaching from outside, and the first sign is only a vibration in something that was still.

The card does not say who is at the door. It asks whether you are ready to hear it.
imageAlt: An old closed door in a vast empty room, with faint concentric ripples spreading from a single point on its surface, as if someone had just knocked. No one is there.
